item.description: Miami, FL - December 14, 2025 - In a moving display of unity and generosity, the Miami Beach community rallied together at Sunset Padel to honor a fallen hero and support the family he left behind. Sunset Padel hosted a special fundraising event on Sunday, December 14, in remembrance of Sergeant David Cajuso, a Miami Beach Police Department motor unit officer who tragically lost his life in the line of duty. item.description: Miami, FL - December 15, 2025 - You don’t need snow to feel the magic of the holidays—this year, Miami has officially been crowned America’s top city for Christmas. item.title: WRE News: Pilates Dominates Miami’s Fitness Scene in 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 17, 2025 - Miami is stretching its way to the top, with Pilates officially crowned the city’s favorite workout of 2025. According to new data from ClassPass shared with Axios, Pilates is not only Miami’s most-booked fitness class this year but also the top workout nationwide for the third year in a row, with reservations jumping 66% year over year.
